working_agreement: User authorized implementation of trace-commands, beginning with trace-cli, through validation, commits, pushes and a ready PR for review. Continue in-scope fixes without repeated confirmation. Ask before merging, publishing or paid provider calls. Owner removed pricing from product scope on 2026-11-15 and authorized updating both plans; retain usage primitives for downstream dashboards.

criteria.a1: Offline workspace-scoped trace discovery and run selection without provider startup
criteria.a2: Deterministic escaped timeline with outcomes, relationships and completeness
criteria.a3: Safe explicit export and verifiable bundles through existing APIs
criteria.a5: In-session model, token and cache measurements match offline inspection across foreground, summaries and retries, preserving identities, timestamps and per-metric completeness
criteria.a6: Capture flag/settings/env precedence and sandbox forwarding
criteria.a7: Actionable failure trace hints preserve original errors and JSON output
criteria.a8: Operator shell journal lifecycle including denial, cancellation and capture failures
criteria.a9: Documented workflow, visibility alias migration and credential-free CLI acceptance

a1.check: traceCommand.test.ts and traceStartup.test.ts: exact IDs, session ambiguity, workspace isolation, empty/corrupt/unreadable journals, symlink rejection; process commands succeed without credentials and with invalid provider/MCP/settings files. Review fixes: scoped selection; checked descriptor reads and snapshot export tested after append/replacement/symlink; typed omitted records; shared operation predicates; single duration; readable help and unwrapped pipes; bounded list headers, listed_runs coverage and reconciled counts. Fresh full suite: 157 suites, 2884 tests, 65 snapshots. Build, format, Fallow audit and unbuilt Fallow check passed. Built CLI smoke and PTYs at 40/120 columns passed. Follow-up regression tests: normal list truncation keeps listed runs complete without warnings; unscoped selection skips linked sessions and explicit selection refuses them; unpaired terminal duration uses only finite nonnegative payload values. Final focused suite: 63 tests and 4 snapshots passed. CI 43680046312 passed all jobs, including Node 20/24.10.0, Fallow and required gate.
